points.K5: 职业人员与公众的剂量限值

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一道发光的边界线前，一侧是体外射线箭头，一侧是发光的人体轮廓
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a glowing boundary line; on one side are arrows of rays coming from outside, on the other a glowing human body outline, and it waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，讲剂量限值和剂量测量。

shots.scene: 限速牌、尺子、人体轮廓三个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up one by one: a blank round speed limit style sign, a measuring ruler and a human body outline with a glowing spot inside. No people.
shots.narration: 上限是多少，怎么量，体内怎么算。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿到一个小小的剂量计徽章，翻来覆去地看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a small blank dosimeter badge and turns it over curiously in a lab corridor.
shots.narration: 阿杰领到剂量计，觉得没什么用。

shots.scene: 阿杰随手把剂量计扔进抽屉，转身要进门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tosses the dosimeter badge into a desk drawer and turns toward a door with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 他把它丢进抽屉，就想进机房。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，从抽屉里取出剂量计别在他胸前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student, takes the dosimeter badge out of the drawer and clips it onto his chest.
shots.narration: 小研拦下他：剂量计必须戴上。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods.
shots.narration: 为什么要戴？我们从头说起。

shots.section_title: 从剂量单位到限值和测量
shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现四级小台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a small floating four-step staircase icon.
shots.narration: 上一课，我们认识了四个剂量量。
overlay: 从剂量单位到限值和测量

shots.section_title: 从剂量单位到限值和测量
shots.scene: 台阶顶端出现限速牌和尺子图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank round speed limit style sign and a measuring ruler appear on top of the four-step staircase icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课：剂量上限，和怎么测量。

shots.scene: 抽奖箱图标，里面红球随剂量刻度增多
shots.prompt_en: A lottery box icon in which the number of red balls increases as a dial beside it turns up. No people.
shots.narration: 第一类损伤，像抽奖。

shots.scene: 剂量越大，抽中的机会越大；抽中的结果一样
shots.prompt_en: Two lottery boxes side by side, the right one with many more red balls; the drawn red ball is the same size in both. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量越大，中签概率越高。

shots.scene: 抽中的红球大小始终不变
shots.prompt_en: A single red ball shown three times at exactly the same size next to three increasing dose dials. No people.
shots.narration: 但一旦发生，严重程度不随剂量变。

shots.scene: 细胞图标和家谱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blood cell, a thyroid gland outline and a simple family tree. No people.
shots.narration: 例如辐射引起的白血病、甲状腺癌。

shots.scene: 从原点出发的一条直线图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple straight line rising from the origin of a blank graph, with no flat part at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 防护上假设：没有安全阈值。

shots.section_title: 确定性效应：过阈值才出现
shots.scene: 水坝图标，水位低于坝顶时无事
shots.prompt_en: A small dam icon with water below the top of the dam and dry land behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二类损伤，像水漫过堤坝。
overlay: 确定性效应：过阈值才出现

shots.section_title: 确定性效应：过阈值才出现
shots.scene: 水位越过坝顶，越漫越多
shots.prompt_en: The water rises over the top of the dam and the flood behind it grows larger and larger. No people.
shots.narration: 过了阈值才出现，剂量越大越重。

shots.section_title: 确定性效应：过阈值才出现
shots.scene: 皮肤发红、眼睛浑浊、人体疲惫三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: reddened skin on an arm, a cloudy eye lens and a tired body outline lying down. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤红斑、白内障、急性放射病。

shots.section_title: 限值主要管随机性风险
shots.scene: 抽奖箱上加了一个盖子标尺
shots.prompt_en: A lottery box icon with a lid and a ruler marking a maximum fill line. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量限值，主要管住抽奖的风险。
overlay: 限值主要管随机性风险

shots.section_title: 限值主要管随机性风险
shots.scene: 水坝图标，水位远低于坝顶，绿色勾
shots.prompt_en: The dam icon again with the water level far below the top and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确定性效应，靠剂量远低于阈值。

shots.section_title: 职业人员与公众的剂量限值
shots.scene: 两个人形图标：一个戴剂量计穿实验服，一个普通路人
shots.prompt_en: Two simple person icons side by side: one in a lab coat wearing a dosimeter badge, one in everyday clothes. No people.
shots.narration: 限值分两类人：职业人员和公众。
overlay: 职业人员与公众的剂量限值

shots.section_title: 职业人员与公众的剂量限值
shots.scene: 空白表格，四行分别配全身、眼睛、皮肤、手脚图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank table with four rows marked by icons: a whole body outline, an eye, a patch of skin, and a hand with a foot. No people.
shots.narration: 全身、眼晶体、皮肤、手足各有上限。

shots.section_title: 职业人员与公众的剂量限值
shots.scene: 职业人员一列的数值依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The worker column of the blank table lights up row by row with glowing red cells. No people.
shots.narration: 职业人员：有效剂量五年平均每年20毫希。

shots.section_title: 职业人员与公众的剂量限值
shots.scene: 职业人员一列下半部分亮起
shots.prompt_en: The lower rows of the worker column glow red: eye, skin, hands and feet. No people.
shots.narration: 眼晶体20，皮肤和手足各500毫希。

shots.section_title: 职业人员与公众的剂量限值
shots.scene: 五个日历叠在一起，其中一个日历上加了单独的上限线
shots.prompt_en: Five stacked blank calendars with an averaging bar across them, and one calendar with its own separate maximum line. No people.
shots.narration: 职业人员可多年平均，单年也封顶。

shots.section_title: 职业人员与公众的剂量限值
shots.scene: 公众的柱子远低于职业人员的柱子
shots.prompt_en: Two blank bars, the public bar much shorter than the worker bar. No people.
shots.narration: 公众的限值低得多。

shots.section_title: 职业人员与公众的剂量限值
shots.scene: 公众一列的数值亮起
shots.prompt_en: The public column of the blank table lights up with smaller glowing cells. No people.
shots.narration: 公众每年1毫希，眼晶体15，皮肤50。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标旁的上限线大幅下移
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon beside a maximum line that slides far down. No people.
shots.narration: 2011年，眼晶体限值从150降到20毫希。

shots.scene: 放大镜下一只眼睛，晶状体变浑浊
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over an eye icon whose lens turns slightly cloudy. No people.
shots.narration: 研究发现，白内障比想象的更容易发生。

shots.section_title: 做实验的你是职业人员
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在实验台前，身旁铅罐上有电离辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student stand at a lab bench beside a closed lead container with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 用放射源做实验的研究生和科研人员，
overlay: 做实验的你是职业人员

shots.section_title: 做实验的你是职业人员
shots.scene: 两人胸前的剂量计亮起
shots.prompt_en: The dosimeter badges on the chests of the female graduate student and the young male student glow softly.
shots.narration: 都属于职业人员。

shots.section_title: 做实验的你是职业人员
shots.scene: 职业人员手持培训证书，路人头上一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A person icon in a lab coat holds a blank training certificate; a person icon in everyday clothes has a question mark above the head. No people.
shots.narration: 受过培训、懂规则；公众不了解。

shots.section_title: 做实验的你是职业人员
shots.scene: 两条不同高度的上限线
shots.prompt_en: Two horizontal maximum lines at different heights next to the two person icons. No people.
shots.narration: 所以两类人适用不同的限值。

shots.scene: 老周在辐射区门口取下剂量计徽章
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at the door of a radiation area and clips a small dosimeter badge to his chest.
shots.narration: 老周说，他读研时每次进辐射区，

shots.scene: 老周胸前的剂量计特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the small dosimeter badge on the chest of the older man.
shots.narration: 都戴着热释光剂量计。

shots.scene: 剂量计放入读数仪，屏幕空白，日历翻页
shots.prompt_en: A dosimeter badge is placed into a reader device with a blank screen while a calendar flips pages. No people.
shots.narration: 定期读数，算出一年受了多少剂量。

shots.scene: 三层倒三角图标，从下往上亮起
shots.prompt_en: An inverted triangle divided into three layers lights up from the bottom tip to the top. No people.
shots.narration: 防护有三道线。

shots.scene: 最底层亮红：一道硬墙
shots.prompt_en: The bottom layer glows red and turns into a solid wall icon. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量限值：正常工作的硬上限。

shots.scene: 中间层亮黄：一个放射源图标上的较低横线
shots.prompt_en: The middle layer glows yellow, showing a sealed source icon with its own lower line below the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量约束：针对某个源，定得更低。

shots.scene: 顶层亮橙：警报灯和行动箭头
shots.prompt_en: The top layer glows orange with an alarm light and an action arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 参考水平：应急时超过就要行动。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个向下的箭头牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank sign with a large downward arrow on it.
shots.narration: 低于限值，就可以放心了吗？

shots.scene: 限值线下方，柱子继续被往下压
shots.prompt_en: A blank bar already below a red maximum line is pushed further down by a hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不。还要合理可行、尽量低。

shots.scene: 天平一边是剂量，一边是钱袋和人群
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a dose icon on one side and a money bag and group icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 同时考虑经济和社会因素。

shots.scene: 倒三角中间出现齿轮
shots.prompt_en: A gear icon appears in the middle of the inverted three-layer triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 这是防护最优化的核心原则。

shots.scene: 尺子、计算器、放大镜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a ruler, a calculator and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量学：测量、计算、评估剂量。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓和材料方块被电离射线照到
shots.prompt_en: Ionizing rays hit a human body outline and a solid material cube. No people.
shots.narration: 看人体和材料吸收了多少电离辐射。

shots.scene: 手机和信号塔图标被灰色圈出，标“非电离”
shots.prompt_en: A smartphone icon and a cell tower icon inside a grey circle, set apart from the ionizing ray icons. No people.
shots.narration: 手机、基站是非电离辐射，不在此列。

shots.section_title: 外照射与内照射剂量学
shots.scene: 人体轮廓左侧有外来箭头
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with orange arrows coming from a source outside on the left. No people.
shots.narration: 外照射：源在体外。
overlay: 外照射与内照射剂量学

shots.section_title: 外照射与内照射剂量学
shots.scene: 剂量计徽章和电离室图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a small dosimeter badge and a cylindrical ionization chamber. No people.
shots.narration: 用剂量计、电离室来测。

shots.section_title: 外照射与内照射剂量学
shots.scene: 外照射三要素图标：箭头、墙、方位
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sharp arrow, a lead wall and a compass showing directions. No people.
shots.narration: 取决于穿透力、屏蔽和照射方位。

shots.section_title: 外照射与内照射剂量学
shots.scene: 人体轮廓里有几个发光的器官
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with a few organs glowing green from inside. No people.
shots.narration: 内照射：放射性物质留在体内。

shots.section_title: 外照射与内照射剂量学
shots.scene: 试管、身体扫描、计算机模型三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sample tube, a body scanning bed and a computer with a simple body model on screen. No people.
shots.narration: 靠生物样品、体外测量和模型来算。

shots.section_title: 外照射与内照射剂量学
shots.scene: 发光点在体内流动、停留
shots.prompt_en: Glowing dots move through the body outline, some staying longer in certain organs. No people.
shots.narration: 取决于分布、代谢和停留的器官。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标与治疗床图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon and a treatment bed icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量学既保护工作人员，

shots.scene: 老李在空白屏幕前看治疗计划示意
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks at a blank monitor next to a radiotherapy treatment bed.
shots.narration: 也为放疗和核医学治疗做计划。

shots.scene: 皮肤、组织、深部器官的分层剖面，四种颜色的箭头射来
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section with layers: skin, tissue and deep organs; four differently colored arrows fly toward it. No people.
shots.narration: 四种射线，穿透力大不相同。

shots.scene: 黄色乒乓球撞在纸上就停
shots.prompt_en: A yellow ping-pong ball bounces off a thin sheet of paper and stops. No people.
shots.narration: 阿尔法粒子，几厘米空气、死皮就挡住。

shots.scene: α箭头停在皮肤表层，体内器官安然
shots.prompt_en: A yellow arrow stops at the outer dead skin layer of an arm outline; the organs inside are untouched. No people.
shots.narration: 在体外，几乎照不到内脏。

shots.scene: 蓝色箭头穿进皮肤几毫米停住，皮肤发红
shots.prompt_en: A blue arrow goes a short way into the skin and stops; the skin surface turns red. No people.
shots.narration: 贝塔粒子在组织里走几毫米到一厘米。

shots.scene: 皮肤表面一片发红
shots.prompt_en: A patch of skin on an arm outline turns red where a blue arrow stopped. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤剂量可能很大，能量高才深入。

shots.scene: 波浪线穿透整个人体轮廓
shots.prompt_en: Wavy lines pass straight through an entire human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 伽马和X射线穿透强，照到全身。

shots.scene: 红色感叹号放在波浪线旁
shots.prompt_en: A red exclamation icon next to the wavy lines passing through the body. No people.
shots.narration: 它们是外照射的主要危害。

shots.scene: 灰色小球钻入体内，撞上小氢原子弹开
shots.prompt_en: Grey balls dive deep into a body outline and bounce off small hydrogen atom icons, some captured by nitrogen atom icons. No people.
shots.narration: 中子钻得深，被氢散射、被氮俘获。

shots.scene: 全身轮廓整体泛红
shots.prompt_en: The whole body outline glows faint red. No people.
shots.narration: 中子是全身危害最大的元凶。

shots.scene: 平行光束整齐照向人体轮廓
shots.prompt_en: Wide parallel beams shine evenly onto a human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 同样的源，站的位置不同，剂量也不同。

shots.scene: 三幅小图：平行束、四面散射、只照一只手
shots.prompt_en: Three small panels: wide parallel beams on a body, scattered rays from all directions around a body, and rays hitting only one hand. No people.
shots.narration: 平行宽束、四面散射、局部受照。

shots.scene: 平行束中深处器官发亮
shots.prompt_en: Inside the body outline under parallel beams, deep organs glow. No people.
shots.narration: 宽束照射，深部剂量为主。

shots.section_title: 个人剂量计测三个深度
shots.scene: 小研身上三处剂量计亮起：胸前、眼旁、指环
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears three small dosimeters that glow: a badge on her chest, a small one near her eye, and a ring on her finger.
shots.narration: 个人剂量计，测身体特定部位。
overlay: 个人剂量计测三个深度

shots.section_title: 个人剂量计测三个深度
shots.scene: 皮肤剖面上三条深度线，最深一条亮
shots.prompt_en: A skin cross-section with three depth lines; the deepest line glows. No people.
shots.narration: 测深一厘米处，代表全身剂量。

shots.section_title: 个人剂量计测三个深度
shots.scene: 眼睛剖面，晶状体处一条线亮
shots.prompt_en: An eye cross-section with a line glowing at the lens depth. No people.
shots.narration: 测几毫米处，代表眼晶体。

shots.section_title: 个人剂量计测三个深度
shots.scene: 皮肤最表层一条细线亮
shots.prompt_en: A very thin line glows at the surface of the skin cross-section. No people.
shots.narration: 测极浅处，代表皮肤剂量。

shots.section_title: 放射性物质怎样进入体内
shots.scene: 人体轮廓四个入口图标：鼻子、嘴、伤口、针筒
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with four entry icons: a nose with air, a mouth, a small cut on a hand, and a syringe. No people.
shots.narration: 吸入、食入、伤口、注射，
overlay: 放射性物质怎样进入体内

shots.section_title: 放射性物质怎样进入体内
shots.scene: 发光点进入体内
shots.prompt_en: Glowing dots enter the body outline through those four routes. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性物质一进体内，就是内照射。

shots.scene: 四步循环图标逐一亮起
shots.prompt_en: A four-step circular arrow diagram with four blank boxes lights up step by step. No people.
shots.narration: 内照射难算，有四个原因。

shots.scene: 发光点散布在不同组织
shots.prompt_en: Glowing dots spread unevenly through different tissues of the body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 一是源分散在不同组织里。

shots.scene: 发光点沿血管流动
shots.prompt_en: Glowing dots flow along blood vessels from organ to organ. No people.
shots.narration: 二是它随代谢在体内搬家。

shots.scene: 射线射程和器官大小对比
shots.prompt_en: Short and long ray tracks drawn against organs of different sizes. No people.
shots.narration: 三是射程和器官大小决定沉积。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标，发光点慢慢变少
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon beside the body outline while the glowing dots slowly fade. No people.
shots.narration: 四是会一直照，直到排出或衰变完。

shots.scene: 长长的时间轴，起点一个小发光点
shots.prompt_en: A long timeline arrow starting from a small glowing dot. No people.
shots.narration: 摄入后，体内会持续受照很多年。

shots.scene: 时间轴上的柱子被累加成一个总数
shots.prompt_en: Small bars along the timeline are collected into one stacked total bar. No people.
shots.narration: 把这些年的剂量加起来，就是待积剂量。

shots.scene: 大人和小孩图标，各自不同长度的时间轴
shots.prompt_en: An adult icon and a child icon, each with its own timeline, the child's longer. No people.
shots.narration: 成人算五十年，儿童算七十年。

shots.scene: 查表图标乘以摄入量图标
shots.prompt_en: A lookup table icon multiplied by an intake amount icon equals a dose icon. No people.
shots.narration: 捷径：查剂量系数，乘以摄入量。

shots.scene: 发光的源器官向旁边的靶器官发出箭头
shots.prompt_en: A glowing source organ sends arrows to a nearby target organ. No people.
shots.narration: 核医学里，常看一个器官照另一个。

shots.scene: 源器官像暖炉烤着周围器官
shots.prompt_en: The glowing source organ looks like a little heater warming the organs around it. No people.
shots.narration: 就像暖炉烤着旁边的人。

shots.scene: 累积活度图标乘以查表图标
shots.prompt_en: A pile of glowing dots icon multiplied by a lookup table icon with a simple body model. No people.
shots.narration: 累积活度乘S值，查标准体模表。

shots.scene: 三个时钟图标：原子、肾脏、怀表
shots.prompt_en: Three clock icons: one with an atom, one with a kidney, one pocket watch. No people.
shots.narration: 体内活度减少，看三个半衰期。

shots.scene: 一堆发光原子一半熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A pile of glowing atoms where half of them go dark. No people.
shots.narration: 物理半衰期：一半原子衰变的时间。

shots.scene: 原子钟摆不受外界影响
shots.prompt_en: An atom clock ticking steadily, unaffected by hands trying to push it. No people.
shots.narration: 只由原子核决定，谁也改变不了。

shots.scene: 肾脏和膀胱图标，发光点被排出
shots.prompt_en: Kidney and bladder icons with glowing dots flowing out. No people.
shots.narration: 生物半衰期：身体排出一半的时间。

shots.scene: 排出过程与衰变无关的两条独立路线
shots.prompt_en: Two separate paths: one showing excretion, one showing decay, with no link between them. No people.
shots.narration: 靠排泄和代谢，和衰变无关。

shots.scene: 水滴图标快速流走
shots.prompt_en: A water drop icon flowing away quickly. No people.
shots.narration: 含氚的水，约十天排走一半。

shots.scene: 甲状腺图标里发光点久久不散
shots.prompt_en: A thyroid gland icon where glowing dots stay for a long time. No people.
shots.narration: 甲状腺里的碘-131，约八十天。

shots.scene: 骨头图标里发光点像钙一样嵌住
shots.prompt_en: A bone icon with glowing dots locked inside like calcium. No people.
shots.narration: 锶-90像钙一样进骨头，约五十年。

shots.scene: 气泡图标飘散
shots.prompt_en: Gas bubble icons drifting out and fading. No people.
shots.narration: 惰性气体，几分钟到几小时就出去。

shots.scene: 浴缸有两个出水口同时放水
shots.prompt_en: A bathtub icon draining through two outlets at the same time. No people.
shots.narration: 衰变和排出，两个出水口同时放水。

shots.scene: 水位下降比任何单个出口都快
shots.prompt_en: The bathtub water level drops faster than with either outlet alone. No people.
shots.narration: 所以有效半衰期总比两个都短。

shots.scene: 大出口特别亮
shots.prompt_en: The larger, faster outlet glows brighter than the small one. No people.
shots.narration: 谁更短，谁说了算。

shots.scene: 甲状腺图标旁两个时钟
shots.prompt_en: A thyroid gland icon with two clocks beside it, one small and one large. No people.
shots.narration: 看碘-131在甲状腺里。

shots.scene: 两个时钟合并成一个更小的时钟
shots.prompt_en: The two clocks merge into one even smaller clock. No people.
shots.narration: 合起来约七天多，比八天还短。

shots.scene: 小时钟高亮
shots.prompt_en: The small physical clock is highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 这里是物理半衰期说了算。

shots.scene: 三根发光柱子撑起一个屋顶
shots.prompt_en: Three glowing pillars hold up a roof with a shield icon on top. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课有三根支柱。

shots.scene: 第一根柱子：上限线和向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: The first pillar shows a maximum line and a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 限值加优化，划出边界。

shots.scene: 第二根柱子：剂量计徽章
shots.prompt_en: The second pillar shows a dosimeter badge. No people.
shots.narration: 个人剂量计，测量体外照射。

shots.scene: 第三根柱子：体内发光器官和时钟
shots.prompt_en: The third pillar shows a glowing organ inside a body outline and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 器官模型和半衰期，追踪体内照射。

shots.scene: 原子图标和心形图标连在一起
shots.prompt_en: An atom icon and a heart icon joined by a glowing line. No people.
shots.narration: 物理加生物学，守护人的安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现抽奖箱和水坝图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lottery box icon and a small dam icon.
shots.narration: 一类看概率，一类有阈值。

shots.scene: 限值线和向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: A maximum line with a downward arrow below it. No people.
shots.narration: 守住限值，还要尽量低。

shots.scene: 四种射线箭头和剂量计
shots.prompt_en: Four ray arrows of different lengths and a dosimeter badge. No people.
shots.narration: 外照射看穿透力，剂量计要戴好。

shots.scene: 浴缸两个出水口
shots.prompt_en: A bathtub icon with two outlets draining. No people.
shots.narration: 内照射看分布和半衰期。

shots.scene: 两张限值卡片，一高一低
shots.prompt_en: Two blank cards with maximum lines, the worker card higher and the public card lower. No people.
shots.narration: 职业每年20毫希，公众1毫希。

shots.scene: 甲状腺图标和一个小时钟
shots.prompt_en: A thyroid gland icon with one small clock beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 碘-131在甲状腺，有效半衰期约7.3天。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着小剂量计徽章挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a small dosimeter badge on its chest and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 守住限值，算清内外照射！
